card.name: "Not" in "is not approved for" statements
card.fires_on: The word "not" right after "[Drug] is" in boxed-warning sentences such as "is not approved for use in pediatric patients" or "for dementia-related psychosis". It also fires on a space before a number in table headers or section numbers.

modes.label: Not approved for
modes.description: "not" after a drug name and "is" in the sentence saying the drug is not approved for a patient group.

modes.description: A blank gap just before a cycle or section number in a table or heading.
